summary.name: GitBreeze
summary.one_liner: GitBreeze (vershd.io) is an AI-assisted Git GUI client for Windows, Mac, and Linux that simplifies committing, comparing branches, and undoing or resetting commits.
use_cases: Compare two branches to find identical or similar commits
Check whether commits were cherry-picked or merged
Commit pending files without managing the git index
Undo, delete, or reset commits with preview
Amend a commit and review the differences
summary.what_it_does:
GitBreeze is a Git graphical client that aims to make Git easier than the command line. It shows which commits are identical or very similar between two branches and lists commits missing from one branch compared with another. It can use AI to analyse pending files, and lets users select files to commit without working with the git index. Files can be compared against the latest or previous commits, and commits can be amended with the differences visible. Reverting and resetting commits is offered in a simplified form with previews, and users can choose whether to keep working files when erasing commits.</what_it_does>
